<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **28** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3c080a65c8c17af97403fed1c26cddac05f43a6a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `f44475186840ba7a85fe06d09d3eed603f794c56` — the merge of head `f8d18b09257057d12893525766d1d4b292e1c020` into base `3c080a65c8c17af97403fed1c26cddac05f43a6a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin f44475186840ba7a85fe06d09d3eed603f794c56 && git checkout f44475186840ba7a85fe06d09d3eed603f794c56
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 3c080a65c8c17af97403fed1c26cddac05f43a6a f8d18b09257057d12893525766d1d4b292e1c020 && git checkout -B drift-repro 3c080a65c8c17af97403fed1c26cddac05f43a6a && git merge --no-ff f8d18b09257057d12893525766d1d4b292e1c020

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3c080a65c8c17af97403fed1c26cddac05f43a6a
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 3c080a65c8c17af97403fed1c26cddac05f43a6a` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · #23805 · `domain:cli` seat 2 · `os-tesla` · session `session_018t6a5rvqPRvEDMCVVW9kYT` · 2026-10-16T08:51Z · reviewed head `f8d18b09257057d12893525766d1d4b292e1c020`, against GitHub and the branch, not against the report's prose.

1. **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #23805`; the only closing keyword in the body is that one (#23801, #23806 and #23788 appear only in non-closing sentences). `Clause-②: no` at line start in the body and in the changeset, matching claim `6209758755`. The new export `SCAFFOLD_NPM_OVERRIDES` lives in `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts`, and the package's public entry (`src/index.ts`) re-exports only `default as InitCommand` from that module, so the published surface does not widen and the `no` stands. `check-governed-merges --pr 23850`: 0 of 6 paths governed; 295 changed lines.
2. **Premise, measured.** The report re-measured upstream first (`vitest@4.1.12` still peers `@vitest/browser-webdriverio ^4.1.11`, which has no 4.1.12), so the range stays `~4.0.0`. It also falsified the PM's assumption 2: before the change, on npm 10.9.9, `os init -t app`, `-t plugin` and `-t empty` all exited 1 with `edgesOut`, because what they share is `@objectstack/cli`; `os create plugin` exited 0. So the override goes on every standalone template. That is the card's ask ("`os init` / `os create` emit the same `overrides.vitest` = `SCAFFOLD_VITEST_RANGE`"); for `app` and `empty`, the criterion's "equal to their `devDependencies.vitest`" is vacuous, since they declare no vitest. Read in the diff: `renderScaffoldPackageJson` emits `overrides: { ...SCAFFOLD_NPM_OVERRIDES }` for every `os init` template; `create.ts` emits it only when `standalone`, so `--in-repo` gets none (npm reads `overrides` from the root manifest only, and pnpm never reads it). The constant is built from `SCAFFOLD_VITEST_RANGE`, so the two cannot disagree.
3. **Changeset, sentence by sentence.** `@objectstack/cli` `patch`, published. "every template: `app`, `plugin`, `empty`" and "`os create plugin`": the diff. "npm 11 installs the same tree, and pnpm ignores the field": the report's 4/4 on npm 11.21.1. "a bare `npm install -D vitest` is refused with `EOVERRIDE` … `npm install -D vitest@~4.0.0`": measured on an emitted `-t app`. "`os create plugin --in-repo` is unchanged": the `standalone` guard. No `create-objectstack` changeset is owed: the blank template's bytes do not change (the new `POLICY_STAMPS` row stamps the value it already holds), and `scripts/` is not published.
4. **Gates, pinned to the head.** `f8d18b0925` check-runs read at review: 40; 24 success, 7 skipped, 9 `in_progress` (`Test Core` 1–6/6, two `Type Check` lanes, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`). Six skips are `EXPECTED_SKIPS` rows; the seventh, `Registry canary: ${{ matrix.template }}`, is a `schedule` / `workflow_dispatch`-only job (`scaffold-e2e.yml`), the non-PR-event class the tool derives. Landing waits for every check green or an expected skip; this record is not a green reading. The dev's local subset: 85 of 85 derived gate commands exit 0 at the head (`--ran`: 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN); the cli `unit` files importing `init` / `create` (22 files, 501 tests) and `typecheck` ran at `d8a9a54f3` (later commits touch no `packages/cli` file); `create-objectstack` test and typecheck at the head; the stamp script's `--self-test` (battery J added, floor 9 to 10) and `--check`; ablations on three legs and a stamp-red mutation with a control under `main`'s script; real installs 4/4 on npm 10.9.9 and 4/4 on npm 11.21.1 (baseline at `1ecb08a1c`: 3 of 4 exit 1).
5. **Accepted deviations.** (1) The scope widening in item 2, measured. (2) `packages/create-objectstack/src/template-consistency.test.ts`, outside the claim's listed files: a comment-only change. Its comment said the template's override "is not" stamped, which this PR's `POLICY_STAMPS` row makes false, and its earlier wording spelled a path that `check:cross-package-test-inputs` read as a cross-package input. A sentence this PR made false, corrected in the same PR; no assertion changed. (3) A merge of `origin/main` (`43567a8fc`, `scripts/ci` only) before the PR opened. (4) A container restart killed the first unit run, which was re-run in full.
6. **Out of scope.** One `class: a` finding: the published skill's copy-paste manifest (`skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md`, the "Complete Working Example" `package.json` fence) fails `npm install` on npm 10.9.9 with `edgesOut` and installs with `overrides.vitest` added (measured). This is the user-remedy-text family that #23849 carries, so it goes to that card as an enumerated location, not as a new card: pointer comment there. `skills/**` is a Tier H governed surface; the routing is triage's.

**Landing:** once every check on the head is green or an expected skip, this seat flips the PR ready and arms auto-merge through the relay, then follows it to `MERGED`.
